title: The Summary and the Exit Code
objective: Check three names, print a summary line for each, and print how many passed.
hint: Define Test-Tool as in the last step. Then $checks = [ordered]@{ with cmd, where.exe, and collection-missing-tool as keys, each set to Test-Tool. Then a foreach that prints key: value. Then $passed = @($checks.Values | Where-Object { $_ -eq "ok" }).Count, and Write-Output with Passed, $passed, of, and $($checks.Count).
